# Vallée du Kou Anopheles insecticide resistance survey (synthetic)

Entomological survey at ten sites in the Vallée du Kou rice-growing area,
Burkina Faso, in July 2022. Mosquitoes were caught by CDC light trap, human
landing catch or pyrethrum spray catch. Each collection was sorted into pools
of one species and sex, and some pools were tested for insecticide resistance
with WHO tube tests or CDC bottle bioassays (24-hour mortality), and genotyped
at the kdr L1014F locus.

Files: `collection_sites.tsv` (site coordinates in decimal degrees and the
national register code of each site), `collections.tsv`, `samples.tsv` (one
row per pool) and `assays.tsv`.

This dataset is synthetic. It was written by hand as a test fixture for the
tabular-to-stf skill.
